transcript.text: w/m finally died after 12 yrs, whats the best one to buy under £400? family of 5
What is the main thing the washing machine is doing wrong?
it stopped mid-cycle 2 days ago with water still in the drum, won't drain or spin, just hums. 12 yr old Hotpoint

Thanks for letting us know about the water left in the drum. The most common cause is a blockage in the pump filter (also known as the drain filter or trap), which is usually free to fix. On most machines, this is behind a small flap or kick-plate at the bottom front. Please switch the machine off and unplug it first. If it was on a hot wash, give the water time to cool before opening anything. Put towels down and have a shallow tray or baking dish ready, as several litres of water can come out. Unscrew the filter slowly so the water comes out gradually. Don't force it if it won't turn. The app shows a picture and video under your reply. Could you check the filter and tell me what you find — was it clear, did you find and remove something, is there a blockage you can't shift, or does anything look broken?
[Helpful to see: image "Where the pump filter is" — The pump filter is usually behind a flap at the bottom front. Turn the machine off and drain any water first, then twist the filter out to clear it. Typical location — your machine may differ.; video "How to unblock the pump / drain filter" — Typical procedure for clearing a blocked pump filter and drain pump — switch the machine off and drain the water first. Access can vary by model.]
